summary: Added project-scoped data-processing rules for measure-specific row filtering before aggregation.
details: Project Settings now provides a validated rule editor with mapped Dataset Type labels, a consolidated Status toggle, row right-click actions, requested-path conditions, raw-row conditions, revision conflict handling, and JSON review.
Normal Reserving Class Formula terms now define signed aggregation coefficients for every measure.
Generated caches require current processing provenance, and retained temporary-view caches are cleared when rules change.

keep_members rules may target aggregate reserving-class labels (for example an IBNRCAT stored as a combined coverage) whenever a measure is stored at that composite granularity; validation matches the data-engine's full membership tree instead of atomic leaves only.

The rules table and editor read in plain language (Applies When / Row Filter / Action, 'is'/'is any of'/'is not' operators), and one condition can list several values with 'is any of' so equivalent rules collapse into a single row.
Legacy JSON can still contain the retired EEX Formula column without blocking Project Settings or dependent features; the app ignores that field while XLSX templates still require migration.
